title: T-Test Calculator
description: Run real one-sample and two-sample Student's t-tests: t statistic, degrees of freedom and two-tailed p-value from the incomplete beta function.
howto: Choose a one-sample test (data vs a claimed mean) or a two-sample test (compare two groups).
Type each sample as comma-separated numbers.
Press Calculate to get t, df and the two-tailed p-value.
Read the verdict at α = 0.05 and check the assumption notes.

faqs.a: From Student's t distribution via the regularized incomplete beta function — the same computation R and SciPy use — evaluated in your browser.
One-sample compares your data's mean against a claimed value μ₀. Two-sample compares the means of two independent groups using pooled variance.
Roughly normal data (or n ≥ 30 by the CLT) and, for the two-sample version, equal variances. The tool reports each sample's size, mean and standard deviation so you can judge.
